headline: Charles Dančak presents XMODEL-assisted SVA/PSL checks for voltage spikes in an LDO bias line
fact: Charles Dančak of Betasoft Consulting presents an AMS assertion method for an LDO op-amp bias line. XMODEL represents the analog signal as piecewise mathematical expressions; meas_max and meas_min compute extrema over measurement intervals, which SVA/PSL properties can check for spikes missed by point sampling. Assertion evaluation remains clocked and detection depends on the model and measurement setup. This is a presented verification technique, not a general guarantee for arbitrary physical waveforms.
